info.name: Cosolvent API
info.description:
Auto-generated from FastAPI OpenAPI.

**URLs:** Each request includes `protocol`, `host`, `port`, and `path` so Postman shows the route. `raw` uses `{{baseUrl}}` — set **Collection variables → baseUrl** to `http://localhost:18000` (no trailing slash). If the address bar is empty, open the collection and confirm `baseUrl` is set.

**Auth:** Call **Login** under `auth`, then copy `session_token` from response **Headers** → `Set-Cookie`, and add header `Cookie: session_token=<value>` on other requests (or use Postman Cookies).
